eligibility_criteria: Students pursuing higher education who have secured admission on merit may apply. Applicants generally need at least 60% in Class 10 and Class 12 with family income below the specified limit. A higher academic category may require 80% marks with a higher income limit. Eligible locations include Pune, Ahilyanagar, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Hyderabad.

The scholarship supports deserving and financially disadvantaged students pursuing higher education. Selection is based on academic merit and financial need. Exact current eligibility criteria should be verified from the current SKF scholarship application.

The scholarship supports academically strong female students pursuing higher education, particularly engineering and selected science and professional programs. Eligibility depends on academic performance, family income, age, course, year of study and the location of the student's institution.

The program supports academically strong female students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds pursuing engineering and STEM education. Applicants generally need strong Class 10 and Class 12 academic performance and must meet the applicable family income and course requirements.

The scholarship supports deserving and meritorious students who may lack financial resources to pursue education or their chosen field. Eligibility varies by scholarship category and may depend on academic performance, course, sporting or other achievement, and financial need.

The scholarship supports girls newly enrolled in engineering programs in Computer Science, Information Technology or Data Science, AI and ML. First-year applicants generally need 85% in Class 10 and 70% in Class 12, while direct second-year applicants need 85% in Class 10 and 70% in their diploma. Family income must be below ₹8 lakh and the institution must be in an eligible location.

The scholarship is intended to support eligible students pursuing higher education based on the requirements of the specific Queen's Scholarship program. Exact eligibility criteria should be verified because the scholarship name may refer to different programs.

Indian students who have passed Class 12 with at least 60% and are enrolled in the first year of a regular full-time undergraduate degree of at least three years may apply. Household income must be ₹15 lakh or less, with preference given to students below ₹2.5 lakh income. There is no age limit.

The program supports financially disadvantaged students pursuing professional engineering studies. Current criteria include at least 60% in previous examinations, age not exceeding 25 years, family income not above ₹6 lakh and study in specified locations.

The scholarship supports academically strong students from financially constrained families entering professional undergraduate programs such as engineering and medicine. Eligibility can depend on entrance examination performance, academic merit, institution, course and family income.

The IEEE WIE International Scholarship is for IEEE Women in Engineering student members who have completed at least two years of undergraduate engineering study at an accredited institution and have a GPA of at least 3.7 on a 4.0 scale. Applicants must meet the membership requirements.

The scholarship supports students entering selected engineering and technical degree programs. Applicants generally need to meet specified age, academic and family-income requirements, including strong performance in secondary school and science or mathematics subjects.

The scholarship supports students pursuing school, diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate education based on academic performance and financial need. Applicants generally must satisfy age, course, academic performance and family-income conditions. Additional consideration or support may apply to BPL and hostel students.

Indian students pursuing undergraduate general or professional courses may apply. Applicants must have obtained at least 55% in the previous qualifying examination and have annual family income of ₹2.5 lakh or less. Preference may be given to students experiencing a personal or family financial crisis.

The program supports academically deserving students from financially constrained families pursuing professional undergraduate education in India. Current eligibility focuses on first-year students in full-time professional degree programs, with at least 80% in Class 12 and additional financial and family circumstances considered.

The scholarship supports academically strong students from financially disadvantaged families pursuing B.Tech education in eligible districts of Rajasthan. Applicants generally need strong Class 12 performance and family income below the applicable limit, with financial need and BPL status considered.

The National Scholarship Exam is open to students pursuing diploma or degree-level education. Students participate in a scholarship examination and awards are associated with examination performance and ranking rather than a single conventional income-based eligibility rule.

scholarship: OP Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: The scholarship supports students in selected engineering disciplines such as Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and Metallurgical Engineering at eligible institutes. Selection is based on academic performance and institute-specific eligibility, with criteria varying by year of study.

The scholarship supports academically meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. Eligibility generally depends on Class 12 academic performance, with higher percentage requirements for Science and Commerce students, together with a low annual family-income threshold.

The scholarship supports needy and meritorious students pursuing higher education, particularly students in engineering and other professional programs. Academic merit and financial need are considered during selection.

The scholarship supports academically talented students from underprivileged or financially disadvantaged families pursuing education in areas such as intermediate studies, ITI, diploma, engineering, medicine and other professional programs.

The Maharashtra scheme provides educational fee reimbursement to eligible economically weaker students admitted to eligible professional or non-professional courses. Eligibility generally includes Maharashtra domicile, family income up to ₹8 lakh and admission through the applicable centralized admission process. Benefits can differ by gender, course and department.

The scholarship supports female students pursuing computer science, computer engineering or closely related technology fields. Applicants are expected to demonstrate strong academic performance and be enrolled in an eligible full-time undergraduate or integrated technology program.

The scholarship supports female students pursuing higher education, particularly students with academic merit and financial need. Eligibility generally considers academic performance, family financial circumstances and enrollment in an eligible higher-education program.

scholarship: L'Oréal India For Young Women in Science
eligibility_criteria: The program supports young women pursuing science, engineering, medicine, biotechnology, pharmacy and related scientific disciplines. Eligibility depends on academic performance, educational level and family income, with specific percentage and income requirements applicable to the relevant cycle.

The UGAM program supports women pursuing higher education in areas such as science, engineering and management. Eligibility depends on academic background, admission to an eligible program and financial circumstances. Program-specific age and income requirements may apply.

scholarship: Indo-U.S. Fellowship for Women in STEMM
eligibility_criteria: The fellowship supports Indian women pursuing or holding doctoral-level qualifications in basic sciences, engineering, technology, agricultural sciences and medical sciences. The student internship category generally targets women aged 21–35 pursuing a PhD or equivalent medical research degree, while the fellowship category has separate age and qualification requirements.

The scholarship supports female students pursuing AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programs. Family income must generally be no more than ₹8 lakh per year, and selection is based on merit in the qualifying examination and admission to an approved institution.

The scholarship supports specially abled students pursuing AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programs. Applicants generally require at least 40% disability and family income of no more than ₹8 lakh per year.

The scholarship supports needy and meritorious students pursuing higher education. Selection considers academic performance, financial need and the student's educational circumstances, with strong academic performance or distinction generally preferred.

The scholarship supports female students from financially disadvantaged families who demonstrate academic merit. Eligibility generally considers academic performance and family income, with preference given to students who require financial assistance.

The scholarship supports students entering eligible professional and technical programs based on academic merit and specified demographic or category criteria. Published scheme criteria include age limits, academic percentage requirements that vary by category and disability status, and a family-income threshold.
